remarks: Opportunity knocks with this exceptional two-family investment turnkey multifamily home with expansion potential! The lot size can accommodate an additional dwelling, presenting a fantastic investment opportunity. Located in a highly sought-after area with convenient access to the Glenbrook train station, local restaurants, and shopping centers, this home is a commuter's dream. Lovingly maintained by the original owner and passed down to the next generation, it has always received the utmost care.  The first floor features three spacious bedrooms with hardwood floors, two full bathrooms, a fully equipped eat-in kitchen, and a living room. It also includes access to the basement, which boasts a family room, one bedroom with closets, a kitchenette, a washer/dryer hookup, and one full bath. The heating system has been updated for maximum efficiency. The second floor provides ample living space with an eat-in kitchen, one bedroom, one bathroom, hardwood floors, and a washer/dryer unit. There is also access to the attic. At the back of the property is a well-maintained deck. A set of Bilco doors provides exterior access to the basement, which houses oil tanks, a furnace, and a workshop. The property includes ample parking and the potential for additional units. Buyers must verify all facts regarding additional dwellings.
